title: Customer Sales Coordinator
description:
Commercial Sales Coordinator (Manufacturing)

Location: Bristol Permanent Opportunity

Salary - 30,000 - 37,000 + Excellent benefits

We're working with a leading organisation in the Bristol area tahts are looking for a Customer Sales Co-ordinator to join the team at an exciting time.

As a Commercial Sales Coordinator, you will provide critical support across contract management, order processing, customer management, and CRM activities. Working closely with Sales, Operations, Finance, Legal, and Customer Service teams, you will ensure commercial agreements are managed effectively and customers receive an exceptional level of service throughout the order life-cycle.

Key Responsibilities

Contract Management
- Review and analyse customer contracts to identify commercial, financial, operational, logistics, export, and field service requirements.
- Collaborate with internal stakeholders to evaluate contractual obligations and identify potential risks, ambiguities, conflicts, or deviations from agreed scopes of work.
- Support negotiations with internal departments and sales teams to reach commercially viable agreements.
- Monitor contract compliance and ensure appropriate processes are in place to identify and escalate any issues or non-compliance.
- Maintain visibility of financial and legal commitments while ensuring robust due diligence procedures are followed.
- Liaise with Legal and Contract Management teams to obtain guidance and support on commercial contractual matters where required.

Order Management
- Support customer order processing across all regions, working closely with regional coordinators to ensure a seamless customer experience.
- Ensure order accuracy with regard to products, pricing, quantities, and delivery schedules.
- Respond promptly to customer, supplier, and internal enquiries, ensuring issues are resolved efficiently.
- Maintain accurate order records and ensure all documentation is completed, filed, and retained in accordance with company procedures.

Customer Management
- Provide proactive support to customers throughout the order process, ensuring timely communication, order acknowledgements, and delivery updates.
- Manage customer queries, concerns, and complaints through to successful resolution, coordinating with relevant departments as needed.
- Build strong relationships with customers, contractors, agents, and internal teams to promote a customer-centric approach and deliver high levels of service.

Skills & Experience

Essential
- Experience working within a commercial, sales support, order management, or customer service environment.
- Previous experience using order entry systems, ERP/MRP platforms, or similar business systems.
- Strong administrative and organisational skills with excellent attention to detail.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office and web-based business applications.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively across various departments.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Desirable
- Experience within a high-tech, low-volume, high-mix manufacturing or engineering environment.
- Knowledge of contract administration, contract law, or commercial governance processes.
- Experience supporting customer-facing activities and managing customer relationships.
- Familiarity with contract drafting, change order management, planning, and scheduling processes.

Personal Attributes
- Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
- Highly organised with a structured approach to managing workload.
- Customer-focused with a commitment to delivering exceptional service.
- Able to identify risks and recommend practical solutions.
- Collaborative team player who builds positive working relationships across the business.

What You'll Bring

You will be a proactive and detail-oriented professional with a strong commercial awareness and a passion for delivering excellent customer service. You'll thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy working cross-functionally, and be motivated by finding solutions that benefit both customers and the business.

This is an excellent opportunity to join a supportive organisation where you can develop your commercial expertise while contributing to the success of a growing team.

Please apply for a confidential chat.

title: Field New Sales Executive - Service. Lifts, Escalators
description:
Lift Maintenance Service Contracts New Business B2 B Field Sales

Sell a Service You Can Actually Stand Behind

Are you a lift industry salesperson who's at your best opening doors and winning new maintenance contracts, but tired of fighting process, paperwork and a service team that lets you down?

Liftec Express, a leading independent lift and escalator specialist, is growing its sales team. It's looking for a genuine new business hunter to build its lift maintenance portfolio across the Andover / Bath / Southampton / Swindon / Reading territory.

No up-to-date CV? No problem. This starts with an informal & confidential chat with Lisa Nicholls, Head of Sales & Marketing.

The Role at a Glance:

New Business Sales Executive
Field-based: Andover / Bath / Southampton / Swindon / Reading territory

£50,000 £65,000 Basic DOE + £10,000 £15,000 OTE Uncapped
Car allowance + business mileage reimbursed monthly + company mobile
Full-Time Permanent

Leadership: Lisa Nicholls, Head of Sales & Marketing - ex Otis, Schindler, Lift & Engineering Services

Company: Independent lift and escalator specialist in maintenance, repair, installation and modernisation. Formerly part of Otis, now Private Equity-backed by R Capital

Ambition: £100m turnover by 2035

Focus: New Business Lift Maintenance Contracts Long-Term Client Relationships

Values: Doing the Basics Brilliantly Extreme Ownership Customer at the Centre Honesty & Integrity

Who We Are

At Liftec Express, we keep people moving safely and reliably, while building a company our team is proud of and our customers trust.

Previously part of Otis, Liftec is now an independent business with a big ambition: to become a £100m turnover company by 2035. We'll get there by giving property managers, facilities managers, building owners and main contractors outstanding service from a responsive independent partner.

Why More Salespeople from competitors Are Joining

Less red tape, more selling. You won't spend your week chasing approvals. Our quoting system is slick, decision-makers are accessible, and our MD will look at non-standard terms when there's a good reason. One of our recent hires, who joined from a major OEM, says producing a quote, seeing a customer and getting terms approved is far easier here.

A service you won't have to apologise for. Too often in this industry, salespeople win a contract that the service team then can't deliver. Not here. We do proper maintenance visits of around 45 minutes, not a ten-minute box-tick. We make proactive recommendations, manage shutdowns properly and take every customer issue seriously. You'll never look foolish in front of a client because operations let you down.

A team, not a lone wolf. Big companies often leave their salespeople to fend for themselves. Here, the sales team works together and pulls in the same direction, with real support behind you.

Room to grow. As we scale toward £100m, the sales structure will grow with us, including future leadership roles. Lisa will coach and develop strong performers every step of the way.

Earnings that reward results. You'll get a competitive basic plus commission paid on every lift you bring on contract. The best-structured deals earn the most, and good salespeople can earn very well.

A Word from Lisa

"I joined Liftec because it's an ambitious business with huge potential. It's fast-paced with a great team around you and everyone genuinely wants to help. I felt at home very quickly. We're independent, growing rapidly and there's a real opportunity for good salespeople to come in, make their mark and be part of what we're building."

The Opportunity

This is a pure new business role. There's no inherited account book and no renewals. Your mission is to win new lift maintenance contracts across a patch with thousands of lifts in it.

You'll:
- Build and manage your own prospect pipeline
- Target decision-makers across property management, facilities, building ownership and main contractors
- Take opportunities from first contact through to signed contract
- Conduct site visits and consultative customer meetings
- Prepare proposals, presentations and commercial submissions
- Lead and complete tender submissions, including full commercial review
- Negotiate long-term maintenance agreements
- Keep your CRM pipeline and forecasting accurate
- Work with our operational teams to ensure a smooth handover once business is won

Lift service contracts are typically three years and are well written, so some opportunities mean keeping a prospect warm for the long haul. Others can be won quickly, and there are always one- and two-lift wins to be had. You'll need the drive of a hunter and the patience to build relationships over time.

About You

You'll already be selling lift service and maintenance contracts and know how the industry works. This role needs someone who can hit the ground running, so lift industry experience is essential.

You'll bring:
- A track record of winning new B2 B lift service & maintenance customers
- Strong prospecting and pipeline-building skills
- Consultative, relationship-led selling. SPIN-style approaches work really well here.
- The ability to understand customer pressure points and build trust over long sales cycles
- Strong commercial, negotiation and presentation skills
- Experience with proposals and tenders
- Good CRM and forecasting discipline
- A full UK driving licence and willingness to travel

Service sales here is about long-term relationships and understanding what keeps customers awake at night. It doesn't need the deep engineering expertise of modernisation sales. Our modernisation specialists work alongside you when those opportunities arise.

We're looking for people who are open-minded and inquisitive, take extreme ownership, put the customer at the centre and act with honesty and integrity. If that sounds like you, come and help us build what comes next.

Benefits:
- Competitive base salary
- Car allowance
- Pension from day one through Aviva
- 25 days holiday plus bank holidays
- Employee Assistance Programme from day one
- Death in Service cover at three times salary
- Discretionary sickness scheme
- Enhanced maternity and paternity provision, subject to service
- Employee discounts platform
- Employee referral scheme
- Role-dependent incentive scheme

Ready to Open Doors?

Not actively looking, but curious? Good. There's no need for an up-to-date CV. Start with an informal, confidential conversation, and if it feels right, have a chat with Lisa.

Bring the relationships. Build the pipeline. Win the contracts.

Application notice We take your privacy seriously. As you might expect you may be contacted by email, text or telephone. Your data is processed by our talent partner RR (Recruitment Revolution) on the basis of their legitimate interests in fulfilling the recruitment process. Please refer to their Data Privacy Policy & Notice on their website for further details.

title: Account Manager
description:
We're working with a specialist data and technology agency to find an Account Manager who enjoys both client relationships and hands-on delivery. This is not a traditional account role focused mainly on relationship management and upselling. You'll own day-to-day client relationships while also managing projects, coordinating technical and analytical teams, tracking budgets and keeping delivery on track.

What you'll be doing
As an Account Manager, you'll manage multiple client relationships and become a key point of contact across a varied portfolio. Projects can include CRM and platform work, data and insight projects, technology implementations, ongoing retainers and smaller consultancy projects.

You'll turn client requirements into clear briefs, coordinate internal teams and manage delivery from kick-off through to completion. You'll maintain project plans, timelines, risks and dependencies, oversee scope and change control, and coordinate specialist teams to make sure work is delivered on time and within agreed parameters.

Commercial management is also an important part of the role. You'll track budgets, resource and forecasting, monitor profitability and identify risks early. Project values can range from around £5k to £200k, with larger projects supported by the Pod Lead. You'll also identify opportunities and contribute to account growth, without being the primary commercial owner.

You'll work across a range of CRM, data and marketing technology platforms, supporting clients with complex data-led projects and implementations.

What experience you'll need to apply
- Experience in Account Management, Technical Account Management, Customer Success, Service Delivery or a similar client-facing role.
- Experience managing projects across CRM, data, technology, SaaS, software or digital environments.
- Strong hands-on project delivery experience, including timelines, scope, risks, dependencies and change control.
- Experience managing budgets, resource allocation, forecasting or project profitability.
- Comfortable coordinating multiple clients, projects and specialist teams at the same time.
- Experience working with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Experience with CRM, data or marketing technology platforms would be useful.
- Commercial awareness and experience identifying opportunities or contributing to account growth.
- Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical information for different audiences.
